name: Solapur

queries.query: सोलापूर नगर भूमापन कार्यालय मालमत्ता पत्रक नकाशा शहर GIS
queries.scope: Find the local city-survey and property-record custodian and any public parcel-vector map.
queries.result: Maharashtra Land Records lists a Solapur City Survey Officer and a Special Deputy Superintendent for city survey; the Solapur Municipal Corporation Record Keeper manages property cards. The municipal GIS page inspected exposes Sector Boundary, while the separate DP GIS catalogue lists Cadastral Boundary but no parcel layer.

queries.query: Solapur official city survey office property card GIS cadastral parcel map Maharashtra
queries.scope: Cross-check local registration responsibilities and public GIS contents in English.
queries.result: Municipal records office explicitly lists Property Card management; the Maharashtra state BhuNaksha portal is an interactive cadastral map, but a direct city-bound public vector schema/query was not verified. Solapur municipal public GIS evidence is planning/boundary layers, not general lot geometry.

portals.name: Solapur Municipal GIS / DP GIS
portals.observation: Observed municipal GIS layer is Sector Boundary. DP GIS catalogue names City Survey Boundary, Cadastral Boundary and planning layers, but no parcel-lot feature layer was verified.

requests.observation: Municipal GIS page returns an iframe labelled Sector Boundary, not individual parcel polygons.
Municipal DP GIS catalogue lists Cadastral Boundary and City Survey Boundary; inspected map shell is a planning portal, not a verified lot query service.

Official generic state BhuNaksha map route appears in public search results. Direct shell request from this environment timed out; this is not evidence that the provider is down, and no parcel query was attempted.
